title: नजन्मेका आस्थाहरू कवितासङ्ग्रहका कवितामा  आमूल नारीवादी चेतना {Radical Feminist Consciousness in the Poems of Najanmeka Asthaharu Poetry Collection}
nepali: प्रस्तुत अध्ययन कवि उषा शेरचनका नजन्मेका आस्थाहरू कवितासङ्ग्रहभित्र रहेका कविताहरूमा अभिव्यक्त आमूल नारीवादी चेतना अध्ययनसँग सम्बन्धित छ । नारीहरूमाथि हुने गरेका सबै प्रकारका शोषण, दमनको विरोध गरी नारी हक, हितका पक्षमा वकालत गर्ने अवधारणामा आधारित वाद नारीवाद हो । आमूल नारीवाद यसमा आधारित नवीन अवधारणा हो । यस सङ्ग्रहका कवितारुमा के कस्तो आमूल नारीवाद अभिव्यक्त आएको छ भन्ने प्राज्ञिक समस्या समाधान गर्नु नै यस अध्ययनको मुख्य उद्देश्य हो । यस अध्ययनबाट नजन्मेका आस्थाहरू कवितासङ्ग्रहभित्र रहेका प्रायः सबै कवितामा नारीवादी चेतना सशक्त रूपमा आएको निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ । यी कवितामा नारीमाथि हुने गरेका शोषण, दमन र हिंसाका विरुद्धमा विद्रोही तथा प्रतिरोधी स्वरहरू पनि सशक्त रूपमा आएका छन् । प्रायः कविताहरूमा नारीका उत्पीडनलाई नै बिषयवस्तुको केन्द्र बनाइएको छ । नारीका पक्षमा वकालत गरिएका यी कविवताहरूले समग्र नारीहरूलाई चेतना थपिदिएको निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: This study is related to the study of the radical feminist consciousness expressed in the poems contained within poet Usha Sherchan's poetry collection "Najanmeka Asthaharu". Feminism is an ideology based on the concept of advocating for women's rights and interests by opposing all kinds of exploitation and oppression practiced against women. Radical feminism is a new concept based on this. The main objective of this study is to resolve the academic problem of what kind of radical feminism is expressed in the poems of this collection. From this study, the conclusion has been drawn that a feminist consciousness has come through strongly in almost all the poems contained within the poetry collection "Najanmeka Asthaharu". In these poems, rebellious and resistant voices against the exploitation, oppression, and violence practiced against women have also come through strongly. In almost all the poems, the oppression of women itself has been made the center of the subject matter. The conclusion has been drawn that these poems, which advocate on behalf of women, have added consciousness to women as a whole.

informal_english: This study looks into the radical feminist consciousness that comes through in the poems in poet Usha Sherchan's poetry collection "Najanmeka Asthaharu". Feminism is an ideology built on the idea of standing up for women's rights and interests by pushing back against all kinds of exploitation and oppression carried out against women. Radical feminism is a newer take based on this. The main aim of this study is to sort out the academic question of what sort of radical feminism shows up in the poems of this collection. From this study, the takeaway is that a feminist consciousness comes through strongly in pretty much all the poems in the poetry collection "Najanmeka Asthaharu". In these poems, rebellious and resistant voices against the exploitation, oppression, and violence done to women also come through strongly. In just about all the poems, the oppression of women itself has been made the heart of the subject matter. The conclusion drawn is that these poems, which speak up for women, have given women as a whole a real boost in consciousness.
